mapper.select: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_published = TRUE GROUP BY product_id

SELECT review_id, member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, is_published, is_blocked, created_at, updated_at FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_published = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT review_id, member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, is_published, is_blocked, created_at, updated_at FROM reviews WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, is_published, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{body}, #{isPublished}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET rating = #{rating}, title = #{title}, body = #{body}, is_published = #{isPublished}, updated_at = now() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
